> Why isn't the ally symbol shown on the top left of the card?

Because it's only an ally when in play, not when it's in your hand or
ash-heap or library.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
cantila <rogc...@student.luth.se> wrote:
> But Death Pact has the retainer symbol, and BBA for Sabbat has as well
> (IIRC), so it seems ot be it was a misprint?

Any non-retainer non-ally that has a retainer or ally symbol on
the left side is a mistake, yes.

This would include Death Pact (an action) and BBA (a modifier) if
either of those has one of those symbols.
